args.goal: On the completed scored vendor evaluation, click Approve; in the Send for Approval side panel add Category and Location if needed, click Next, review the approval workflow, add remarks, select an approver, click Continue, and stop when the vendor is shown as pending with the selected approver.

steps.note: Perform the approval submission flow that has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the submitted vendor is shown as pending after being sent for approval.
